data.name: Ashab
data.gender_notes: Ashab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Refers to the companions of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who supported him during his mission in spreading Islam. The name Ashab carries the meaning “The Companions” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ashab usually hope their child will grow to embody the companions and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ashab holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam as it represents the companionship and loyalty of the early believers to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It serves as a reminder of the importance of having strong bonds with others and of providing support and guidance to those in need.
data.etymology: Ashab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Companions.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashab total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أصحاب
in_arabic.meaning: أصحاب تعني جمع أصحاب و هم أصحاب النبي و الأصحاب المقربين
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصحاب هو جمع أصحاب و يعني الأشخاص الذين يرافقون النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم و الأصحاب المقربين الذين كانوا معه في حياته و في المعارك و الأحداث الهامة في التاريخ الإسلامي. و الأصحاب هم الذين ساعدوه في نشر الإسلام و في بناء المجتمع الإسلامي الأول.

in_urdu.name: اصحاب
in_urdu.meaning: اصحاب کا مطلب ہے رسول اللہ کے ساتھی اور دوست
in_urdu.long_meaning: اصحاب (Ashab) عربی زبان کا ایک لفظ ہے جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کے ساتھیوں اور دوستوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ لفظ ان حضرات کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو رسول اللہ کے ساتھ تھے اور ان کے ساتھ مل کر اسلام کو پھیلانے میں مدد کی۔ اصحاب کے معنی میں وہ لوگ شامل ہیں جو رسول اللہ کے ساتھ مقرب تھے اور ان کی صحبت میں تھے۔

in_hindi.name: अशाब
in_hindi.meaning: अशाब का अर्थ है नबी के साथी और मित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: अशाब (Ashab) एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ है नबी मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के साथी और मित्र। यह शब्द उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो नबी के साथ थे और उनकी मदद से इस्लाम को फैलाने में सहायता की। अशाब के अर्थ में वे लोग शामिल हैं जो नबी के साथ घनिष्ठ थे और उनकी संगति में थे।

in_english.name: Ashab
in_english.meaning: Ashab means companions or friends of the Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: Ashab (Arabic: أصحاب) refers to the companions and close friends of the Prophet Muhammad. The term encompasses those individuals who accompanied the Prophet, supported him, and played a significant role in spreading Islam. The Ashab were the Prophet's closest associates, and their company and camaraderie were instrumental in shaping the early Muslim community.

Their courage, loyalty, and fortitude served as a beacon for future generations, inspiring Muslims to emulate their virtues and preserve their legacy.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the term "Ashab" signifies the deep bond and connection that exists between the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his followers. These companions were chosen by Allah to be his close friends and guides, living their lives in accordance with the Prophet's teachings and embodying the Islamic virtues. Their unwavering faith and dedication to Allah serve as an inspiration for all Muslims today, reminding us of the importance of remaining steadfast in our beliefs and striving towards righteousness.

historical_references.context: A group of young men known as the Seven Sleepers of Ephesus retreated into a cave to escape persecution during the Roman Empire. They fell into a deep sleep and were awakened 200 years later by a passing shepherd. The group became known as Ashab al-Kahf (People of the Cave) in Islamic tradition.
